project: Spurious Background Reliance in Bird Classification
checkpoint_selection: Best checkpoint selected by validation worst-group accuracy; held-out test evaluated after selection
limitations: Three seeds only; no statistical significance claim.
GroupDRO is a minibatch implementation and is not claimed as an exact canonical reproduction.
Grad-CAM is qualitative inspection, not causal evidence.
Results are specific to the Waterbirds benchmark and do not establish elimination of shortcut reliance.
data_note: These files contain aggregated final results. Per-example predictions, model checkpoints, and full run-level raw outputs are not included.
